page.overview:
Who is Yazoo?

Yazoo is one of the three Remnants of Sephiroth, along with Loz and Kadaj, who are the antagonists of Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children. He embodies Sephiroth's allure, and has a cool demeanor. Yazoo often battles alongside his brothers and is the quietest remnant.

Like the other embodiments of Sephiroth's will, Yazoo has green cat-like eyes and silver hair; his hair is long and layered, extending partway down his back. Yazoo is the tallest of his brothers and has a lean yet muscular build.

Yazoo wears a long black leather coat, boots, and trousers. He wears his coat zipped to his neck and the lower half zipped up above his knees, though he opens it up when riding his motorcycle. The image of a single wing is sewn on the back of his coat as an allusion to Sephiroth. He wears black leather gloves and shoulder guards with straps crossing over his torso. He fights using a Velvet Nightmare handgun and carries it in a holster on his lower back, and in battle wields it with his left hand. Because of his height, hair, and outfit, Yazoo resembles Sephiroth the most of the three remnants.

Yazoo embodies Sephiroth's allure and cool personality. Calm, soft-spoken, and reserved, Yazoo has few facial expressions and rarely shows strong emotions, limited to moments such as when Reno insults Jenova, or when Cloud Strife slices apart his Velvet Nightmare gun. Despite his aloof demeanor, Yazoo's more playful side shows when bantering with his brothers, particularly when light-heartedly teasing Loz, or maliciously taunting the Turks. Yazoo is somewhat more expressive and sadistic when fighting, often coldly smirking and quietly laughing. He displays crazed excitement during his takedown of the Turks' helicopter before recomposing himself, which hints at a shade of instability.
